newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paribas unit not for sale today - spokesman.
newsitem.headline: Paribas unit not for sale today - spokesman.

text.p: Paribas unit Via Banque, controlled through its Navigation Mixte subsidiary, is not for sale today, a Paribas spokesman said on Friday.
"Via Banque is not for sale today," the spokesman told Reuters. "Over the long term, it has no place in Groupe Paribas."

The spokesman was commenting on remarks made by Paribas chairman Andre Levy-Lang in an interview with weekly Le Journal des Finances to be published on Saturday. "Via Banque will not be part of Paribas in the long term and will therefore have to find another core shareholder," Levy-Lang said in the interview.
Via Banque was the biggest gainer on the Paris bourse, up 18.43 percent at 158.7 francs while Paribas hit a year high of 369.0 francs just before closing up 5.04 percent at 368.7.
Paribas shares rose about 12 percent on the week, energised by a merger of Axa and UAP which traders said may be the beginning of a restructuring in the French financial sector.
